slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【领地“不忘危”坐标记录中……】

【领地“不忘危”已录入天启大陆·东启区域地图】

【恭喜玩家还我三星五费！！！成为“不忘危”的领主】

对话框一个个弹出。

李知已经踏上了下山的路。

瀑布溅出水花，落在她的斗篷上，带着凉意。

李知接住水珠，甩在岩石缝隙里钻出的野花花瓣上。

它轻轻晃动，水珠在花瓣留下一小串水滴，又落入雪中。

李知踩在雪上，脚步越来越轻快，渐渐跳跃起来。

能从岩石里长出来的花，早已经有了扎根的养分，能接住天降的雨露，也能放任压弯花瓣的水珠滑落。

多么的生机勃勃。

她在这一刻，又更爱这片领地了。

山下依旧白雪皑皑，但越靠近溪流越化冻。

李知蹲在溪流边，手指在冰冷的水中晃荡着，思索应该怎么分配这300平米。

这片领土的划分，其实她也是按照溪流对两片土地的划分来划分的。

一半200平米，一半100平米。

如果要在这里开交易所，必然是要将200平米这片土地留给交易所。

但李知并不打算将交易所的总部设立在这里。

虽然这是她的领地，也可以说是一片“中立”的土地。

但也因为这只是名不见经传的一个临时领主的领地，她的交易所想要

交易所要壮大，又出现在大众的视野里，不仅需要广为人知，更需要借势。

双月城和圣影城，依旧是目前最好的选择。

再次一档，也应该是浓绿集市或者羽灵族的羽灵大道。

总之，不能是目前名不见经传的“不忘危”。

李知有了决断，就将建造台放在了200平米的土地上，同时掏出昨天让为她们宿舍区画建筑图纸的女工和闻画的，一张四四方方的建筑图纸。

黑店是以杂货铺的形式出现，需要有展示不同物品的空间。

Dialog boxes pop up one after another.

Li Zhi had already embarked on the way down the mountain.

The waterfall splashed water and fell on her cloak, bringing a cool feeling.

Li Zhi caught the water droplets and threw them on the petals of wild flowers that emerged from the cracks in the rocks.

It swayed slightly, and the water droplets left a small string of water droplets on the petals, and then fell into the snow.

Li Zhi stepped on the snow, his footsteps became lighter and lighter, and he gradually jumped.

Flowers that can grow from rocks already have the nutrients to take root. They can catch the rain and dew that fall from the sky, and they can also let the water droplets that bend the petals slide down.

How vibrant.

At this moment, she fell in love with this territory even more.

The mountains are still covered with snow, but the ice is thawing as we get closer to the stream.

Li Zhi squatted by the stream, his fingers dangling in the cold water, thinking about how to allocate the 300 square meters.

In fact, she divided this territory according to the division of the two lands by the stream.

Half is 200 square meters, half is 100 square meters.

If you want to open an exchange here, you must leave 200 square meters of land for the exchange.

But Li Zhi does not plan to set up the headquarters of the exchange here.

Although this is her territory, it can also be said to be a "neutral" land.

But also because this is just the territory of a little-known temporary lord, her exchange wants

For an exchange to grow and appear in the public eye, it not only needs to be widely known, but also needs to take advantage of the momentum.

Shuangyue City and Holy Film City are still the best choices at present.

The next level should be the Dark Green Market or the Yuling Avenue of the Yuling Clan.

In short, it cannot be the currently unknown "not forgetting danger".

Li Zhi made a decision and placed the construction platform on 200 square meters of land. At the same time, he took out a boxy architectural drawing that the female worker and Wen Hua had asked to draw the architectural drawings for their dormitory area yesterday.

Black stores appear in the form of grocery stores and require space to display different items.
